class_name: 推量-不確実-カモシレナイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Marks a possibility the speaker treats as real but unconfirmed, and it is the default hedge in both speech and writing (雨かもしれない); it commits less than だろう. It attaches to plain forms, and after a noun or na-adjective the copula だ drops (静かかもしれない). Clipping it to かも is casual; the sibling かもわからない says the same thing in a spoken, non-standard register.

examples.ruby: その話[はなし]、ただの噂[うわさ]かもしれないよ。
examples.english: That story might be nothing but a rumor, you know.

examples.ruby: 急[いそ]げば最終[さいしゅう]バスに間[ま]に合[あ]うかもしれない。
examples.english: If we hurry we might still make the last bus.

examples.ruby: 傘[かさ]は電車[でんしゃ]の中[なか]に置[お]き忘[わす]れたかもしれません。
examples.english: I may have left my umbrella behind on the train.

patterns.usage_note: Marks a possibility the speaker treats as real but unconfirmed, identical in meaning to かもしれない but built on 分かる instead of 知れる (寒いかもわからん). The difference is register, not nuance: it is a spoken form that many speakers hear as non-standard, so writing uses かもしれない. The contracted かもわからん is the most common shape.

examples.ruby: あの店[みせ]、この時間[じかん]だともう閉[し]まっているかもわからない。
examples.english: That shop may well be shut already at this hour.

examples.ruby: 今年[ことし]の冬[ふゆ]は思[おも]ったより寒[さむ]いかもわからん。
examples.english: This winter could turn out colder than we figured.

examples.ruby: 犯人[はんにん]は案外[あんがい]身近[みぢか]な人物[じんぶつ]かもわからないぞ。
examples.english: The culprit might just be someone close to us.
